query_shortcut_audit.result: BioMaster V1 target-query pair signal is supported in S2/S3/S5, but drug-query pair signal is not supported in S2 or S3.

simple_neutralization_audit.scope: S3 development folds 0-2 only; confirmation folds 3-4 were not read
simple_neutralization_audit.result: Cross-fold target score mean neutralization reduced drug-macro AUPRC from 0.62209149 to 0.61828957; paired group bootstrap CI [-0.04890237, 0.04092232]; drug-query permutation gate remained false.

new_required_gate_if_stage0_passes.name: drug_query_pair_signal_beyond_group_prior
new_required_gate_if_stage0_passes.definition: Within each old-drug query group, permute candidate-target ordering while preserving that drug's score distribution. The full EQIR drug-macro AUPRC must exceed the 95th percentile of this null distribution.
new_required_gate_if_stage0_passes.rationale: Micro-AUPRC or a preserved drug-level score prior does not demonstrate old-drug-to-new-target pair ranking.
applies_to: all directional ablations used to attribute the gain

prohibited_claim: Target score centering, query-prior subtraction, or calibration alone is not an algorithm novelty and cannot substitute for pair-level incremental evidence.
